digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter transport pagination / fetcher reconciliation boundary
propositions: _paged_search loop exits only when batch is empty, but a server that ignores startAt re-serves the same page forever, causing unbounded iteration (26+ calls in the defect scenario).
get_parent_map wraps _paged_search in a bare except Exception handler that converts any pager abort into a silent empty map {}, neutralizing loud stall signals at the caller.
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) wrap their whole-project DC readers in broad except Exception fail-opens that swallow stall errors at the fetcher boundary.

A startAt-ignoring server repeating the same page must raise loudly rather than degrade silently, mirroring the design invariant in fetcher._iter_pages and the Cloud sibling acli_graph fix (bug cabc).
The stall error must belong in core _backend.py as BackendPaginationStallError so that both adapters and fetcher can name it without layering inversion.
